astronomy.positions: Reuse Skyfield 1.54 / DE440s apparent geocentric true ecliptic/equinox of date, seven classical planets; existing Western behavior unchanged.
astronomy.anchor_definition: 1956-03-21 00:00 TT, revised IAE1985 Lahiri 23 degrees 15 minutes 0.658 seconds; not original ICRC 0.000 seconds or fixed-star true-Citra.
astronomy.transport: Remove Skyfield IAU2000A longitude nutation at anchor. Rotate date mean-ecliptic equinox through ICRS to anchor mean ecliptic using Skyfield Capitaine et al. 2003 precession. Subtract its anchor-frame longitude from mean anchor. Add date longitude nutation for true ayanamsha; subtract true ayanamsha from apparent longitude/Ascendant.
astronomy.model_limit: Explicit Skyfield realization, not bit-identical to Swiss default Vondrak/IAU1980 realization. Exploratory 1850–2149 comparisons differ about 0.14 arcsecond; no empirical fitted correction applied.
astronomy.nodes: IERS2010 chapter 5 equation 5.43 mean lunar ascending-node polynomial in TT centuries; add longitude nutation to express tropical true-equinox node; Ketu exactly opposite. No true/osculating node fallback.
astronomy.speeds: Differentiate sidereal coordinates, including ayanamsha drift; retrograde is the sidereal longitude derivative sign.
astronomy.scope: Astronomical epochs 1850–2149; core locations abs(latitude)<66 degrees. Pinned IANA civil input, explicit DST fold, rejected gaps; inherited modeled UT1 and pre-1972 proleptic UTC limits.

symbolic.houses: D1 whole-sign from sidereal Lagna; keep rashi and cusp/bhava alternatives separate.
symbolic.nakshatras: 27 equal sectors from 0 sidereal Aries; four equal padas each; exact half-open boundaries with floating representation tolerance disclosed.
symbolic.vimshottari_default: pvr-2000-savana: fixed elapsed 360-day years; secondary option solar-365.2425 uses fixed elapsed 365.2425-day years. Both supported explicitly by PVR discussion; do not call either universal.
symbolic.dasha_time: UTC elapsed timedelta days, no future leap-second accumulation; start included/end excluded. At birth backdate the full first MD by elapsed fraction; subdivide full MD, not remaining balance, into ADs.
symbolic.d9: Nine equal 3 degree 20 minute parts, movable/fixed/dual starts at self/ninth/fifth; zodiac order. Report harmonic longitude as symbolic, not astronomical sky position. Houses counted from D9 Lagna, never D1 Lagna.
symbolic.lords: Seven classical sign lords; node co-rulership/dignity variations explicitly unsupported.
symbolic.dignities: Seven-planet sign ownership/exaltation/debilitation and unambiguous moolatrikona intervals; no scoring. PVR p.34 Mars paragraph says Leo while table says Aries: degree-specific Mars moolatrikona remains unsupported.
symbolic.aspects: Full Parashari whole-sign graha drishti: seventh for classical seven; Mars fourth/eighth, Jupiter fifth/ninth, Saturn third/tenth. No Jaimini rashi drishti, degree-strength interpolation or node-aspect rule inferred.
